details: Found by the front 30 Oct, twice in one hour: the cycle runs for the-change-cycle-script-lands-a-ready-change-its and one-digest-per-wave-instead-of-status-messages both ended 'stopped_at: check, the check closed with no test for the queue item (q1_test is empty)' although each check had open 0, a green gate and a new test file (tests/test_land_waits.py, tests/test_digest.py). The front closed each item by hand with `relay queue done --test`, one extra round per feature.
failing_case: A cycle run of a feature change whose check is open 0, gate green, and which adds tests/test_x.py ends with stopped_at check and q1_test empty.
pass_cases: A feature change with open 0 and an added test closes its item in the cycle
A change that adds no test still stops with a line naming the missing test
A fix item's q1_test behaviour is unchanged
reason: tests/test_cycle_workflow.py::test_feature_item_with_empty_q1_test_is_picked_by_the_closer passes and fails at the base 817500dd.
findings.summary: A feature's check stops the cycle with no test named

details: CONFIRMED by reading. cycle.js:262 decides "feature" as it.kind undefined/change/built. it.kind is the cycle unit's kind
(KINDS change, built, fix, recheck; unit validation at cycle.js:91-102), and unit kind fix means a fix round that needs fix,
fixes and findings (cycle.js:100). The queue item's kind (fix or feature, relay_queue.py:46) is never read by the cycle, and the
unit carries only the item slug. So every queue fix item built through changeUnit counts as a feature here.
The new test encodes pass case 3 as a cycle unit of kind fix (test_cycle_workflow.py: unit(kind="fix", fix="f", fixes="f.md",
findings="r.json", item="i")), which is a fix round, not a fix item, so it passes while the promise is broken.
Damage is bounded: relay queue done (relay_queue.py check_refusal) still needs a check with Q1 MET for a fix item, so an unchecked fix
cannot close; but the item's recorded proof becomes whatever test a runner picked, and the queue's test field is what later reads trust.
evidence: sed -n 88,102p cycle.js: "const kind = it.kind || 'change'" ... "if (kind === 'fix') for (const f of ['fix', 'fixes', 'findings']) ... is kind fix and needs ${f}"
cycle.js:262: const pick = !ck.q1_test && (it.kind === undefined || it.kind === 'change' || it.kind === 'built')
relay queue show a-feature-s-check-stops-the-cycle-with-no-test-n: "fix, ip 86, 30m, taken by wt/a-feature-s-check-stops-the-cycle-with-n"; pass case "A fix item's q1_test behaviour is unchanged"
failing_case: A queue item of kind fix (like this very item, "fix, ip 86") is built as a cycle unit of kind change (the normal case: unit kind
fix is only a fix round with fix/fixes/findings). The checker returns open 0 with q1_test "" (it forgot to name the Q1 test).
Before this change: stopped_at check, "the check closed with no test for the queue item (q1_test is empty)".
Now: pick = true (it.kind is undefined), the close runner is told to pick any test from the added files and runs
relay queue done <item> --test <picked>; the fix item is closed with a test nobody showed fails without the fix, and the cycle
result says test "picked by the closer". It should still stop at check, as before (brief pass case 3: "A fix item's q1_test
fix_hint: Decide on the queue item's kind, not the unit's. Smallest: have the close runner read it first: "Run relay queue show <item> -C <wt>;
if its first line says fix, run nothing and report BLOCKED with 'the check closed with no test for the queue item (q1_test is empty)'",
and keep the pick for feature. Cleaner: the cycle asks for the kind once (or the checker's CHECK schema returns item_kind) and
branches in code (principle 5: a fact goes to code). Rewrite the test so pass case 1 uses a change unit whose item is a fix.
pass_cases: 1. Queue item kind fix, unit kind change, check open 0, q1_test "": stopped_at "check", detail names the empty q1_test, no "close queue item: <item>" label.

2. Queue item kind feature, unit kind change, check open 0, q1_test "", change adds tests/test_x.py: ready, the close prompt carries the diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM command (today's behaviour kept).
3. Queue item kind fix, unit kind change, q1_test "tests/test_x.py::T::test_a": close prompt is exactly "relay queue done <item> -C <wt> --test tests/test_x.py::T::test_a" (unchanged).
4. Queue item kind feature, close runner reports BLOCKED "no test for the queue item: the change adds no test": stopped_at "close queue item" with that line (unchanged).
reason: test_fix_item_built_as_a_change_unit_with_empty_q1_test_stops_at_check passes; failed at 5410d352. cycle.js picks by ck.item_kind.
findings.summary: the picker is chosen by the cycle unit's kind, not the queue item's kind, so a queue fix item with an empty q1_test is closed with an arbitrary added test (pass case 3 broken)

details: CONFIRMED by reading: fixUnit (cycle.js:403-410) calls finish with the same it, and finish uses it.kind to decide the pick. The same
root as F1 (unit kind used as item kind); one fix that reads the queue item's kind meets both. Whether the front ever sends a kind
fix unit with a feature item is not measured; the unit validation allows it (cycle.js:96 only refuses item outside relay mode).
Size: 5 minutes once F1 is fixed.
evidence: cycle.js:409: return finish(it, st, { findings: it.findings, fixes: fixesText(it.fixes, st), gateLog: r.g.gate_log, review: undefined })
cycle.js:262-263: pick false for it.kind 'fix' -> stop(it, 'check', 'the check closed with no test for the queue item (q1_test is empty)')
failing_case: A feature change whose landing hit a take conflict is sent back as a cycle unit of kind fix (fix "take master and resolve <files>",
findings, fixes) that still names its feature queue item (item = <feature slug>). The check is open 0, the gate green, the change
added tests/test_x.py, and the checker leaves q1_test "". Now: pick is false because it.kind is 'fix', so the run ends
stopped_at check, "the check closed with no test for the queue item (q1_test is empty)": the brief's failing case again.
It should close the feature item with a picked test, as for a change unit.
fix_hint: Covered by F1's fix: branch on the queue item's kind, whatever the unit's kind.
pass_cases: 1. Unit kind fix with item = a feature item, check open 0, q1_test "", added tests/test_x.py: ready, close prompt carries the pick instruction.
2. Unit kind fix with item = a fix item, q1_test "": stopped_at check (F1's pass case 1).
3. Unit kind change with item = a feature item, q1_test "": ready (today's behaviour kept).
findings.summary: a feature item finished through a fix unit (a take-conflict or front-ordered fix round) still stops at check with q1_test empty

details: CONFIRMED by reading cycle.js:265 against relay_queue.py:1489 TEST_FORMS. Correct for the two cases that prompted the item; fragile
for agent-text features. Only the fallback path is hit (the checker may already name the eval). Size: 5 minutes.
failing_case: A feature change to an agent text adds evals/plugin/<case>/ (a test form relay queue done accepts: evals/plugin/<case>::<grader>)
and no tests/ file; the checker leaves q1_test "". The closer filters the added files to tests/ or test_*, finds none, and
reports BLOCKED "no test for the queue item: the change adds no test", although the change added a test.
fix_hint: Add "or under evals/" to the filter and name the eval form from TEST_FORMS in the prompt.
pass_cases: 1. Added evals/plugin/foo/prompt.md only, q1_test "": the close prompt allows picking evals/plugin/foo::<grader>; item closes.
2. Added tests/test_x.py, q1_test "": unchanged, item closes with a test of tests/test_x.py.
3. No test or eval case added: BLOCKED with the missing-test line (unchanged).
findings.summary: the closer's pick keeps only files under tests/ or named test_*, so a feature whose only test is an eval case is reported as adding no test
